name: r-rent-rental-cars
description: R-Rent rental platform and safely gated serverless APIs

scripts.workers:check: node scripts/cloudflare-preflight.mjs check staging && node --test tests/cloudflare-worker.test.js
scripts.workers:deploy:staging: node scripts/cloudflare-preflight.mjs deploy staging && npx --yes wrangler@4.147.0 deploy --env staging
scripts.workers:deploy:production: node scripts/cloudflare-preflight.mjs deploy production && npx --yes wrangler@4.147.0 deploy --env production
scripts.workers:dry-run: node scripts/cloudflare-preflight.mjs check staging && npx --yes wrangler@4.147.0 deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler-build --env staging
